Class Recognition

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.authentication.Recognition
Direct Known Subclasses:
Login, SignUp
public abstract class Recognition extends Object
Abstract template for authentication workflows. The perform() method runs validation, generates a token on success, and then delegates to redirection().
